overall_assessment: Core splitting works well: learning_outcomes, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements and reading_list are correct and complete in nearly all courses, and the obligatory activity is correctly separated from assessment. The main defects are scraping cruft (semester-picker widget in course_content, exam-logistics/page footer in assessment) and admission text in prerequisites. Most pre-pass 'boilerplate' flags are false alarms (identical but genuine text across TYSDI offerings).

findings.description: Every course_content row is wrapped in the page's semester-picker widget: a 'Vel emnebeskrivelse for semester' header followed by a long list of '2026 Haust (Noverande semester) 2025 Vår ...' entries, repeated again at the end with a leading '>'. The real 'Mål og innhold' text is only a small part of the row, and the list length leaks the year range/time of scraping. The row is not clean per the rubric.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The uib CSS selector (multi-mode) for the course-content block captures the semester dropdown component along with the content; the pre-pass did not flag it because it is in all courses with varying text. The text is not removed in .clean_sections() or anonymization.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R) or an uib-specific cleaner, drop the lines 'Vel emnebeskrivelse for semester', the following line of 'YYYY Vår|Haust (...)' entries, and the '> YYYY Vår ...' line (regex ^>?\s*(20\d\d (Vår|Haust)( \([^)]*\))?\s*)+$). Better: fix the selector to exclude the picker element.

findings.description: Assessment ends with an exam-logistics table (Vurderingsordning, Innleveringsfrist, Trekkfrist, Eksamenssystem Inspera, Dato, Varigheit) and page navigation/footer text ('Dette bør du vite om eksamen', institute name, 'Til toppen'). It also contains stray 'Vurderingssemester' fragments ('Vår og haust', 'Haust. Der er òg vurdering tidleg i vårsemesteret ...', 'Ingen', '-', 'Ikkje relevant.', 'Ikkje aktuelt.'). Exam logistics/navigation do not belong in assessment per the recipe.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The trailing exam block (and 'Vurderingssemester' / 'Hjelpemiddel' values) is appended to the 'Vurderingsformer' section because no heading in R/section_heading_map.R terminates it ('Vurderingsordning', 'Dette bør du vite om eksamen', 'Karakterskala', 'Vurderingssemester').
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() for uib, cut assessment at the first line matching ^Vurderingsordning$ and strip lines 'Dette bør du vite om eksamen', 'Til toppen', 'Lukk', the institute-name footer, and bare placeholders (-, Ingen, Ikkje relevant, Ikkje aktuelt). Optionally map 'Vurderingssemester' to a drop-section.

findings.description: A site error banner ('Vi opplever problemer med å hente inn eksamensinformasjon...') plus 'Lukk' and a course title is appended to the assessment text in courses whose exam info could not be fetched. It is page-level boilerplate, and the course title shown is even for a different course name than the one in the metadata (TYSDI111 2016 shows 'lektorutdanningen 3').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The banner sits at the top of the plan text, is not recognised as a heading, and ends up attached to the last assessment block (or preamble is merged forward) in the extractor; also not stripped by anonymization.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the banner paragraph, 'Lukk', and the following title line in .clean_sections() (or earlier in the uib text cleaning) with a regex on 'Vi opplever problemer med å hente inn eksamensinformasjon'.

findings.evidence: Opptak til lektorutdanning ved Det humanistiske fakultet.
findings.description: Prerequisites concatenates 'Krav til forkunnskaper', 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' and 'Krav til studierett'. The studierett/admission lines ('Opptak til lektorutdanning...', 'Emnet er ope for alle med studierett ved Universitetet i Bergen') are admission text, not prerequisites per the codebook, and placeholder 'Ingen' lines are included as separate paragraphs.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading map sends 'Krav til studierett' (and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper') to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Krav til studierett' to a dropped/other section instead of prerequisites; keep 'Krav til forkunnskaper' and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper'; drop lines that are just 'Ingen'/'-'.

findings.evidence: Det arrangeres kontinuasjonseksamen for studenter med gyldig fravær etter § 5-5 i Studieforskriften ved UiB.
findings.description: Assessment contains the generic continuation-exam/Studentweb boilerplate (kontinuasjonseksamen rules, 'melde deg opp sjølv i Studentweb'), the 'Rett til ny vurdering' label, and two Vurderingsordning tables (ny eksamen and ordinary) with different dates; the actual assessment is one sentence. This is admin boilerplate and exam logistics, not assessment content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Master-level UiB pages put the 'Vurderingssemester' text with continuation-exam rules after Vurderingsformer; it is not cut off by a heading boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat 'Vurderingssemester' as a section boundary (drop its content) and add a boilerplate-strip rule for the kontinuasjonseksamen paragraph block.

findings.evidence: Studentane evaluerer undervisninga ved slutten av semesteret i tråd med fastsette prosedyrar for undervisningsevaluering.
findings.description: In older TYSDI plans, the Emneevaluering sentence is inside the 'Vurderingsformer' body on the page and ends up in assessment (course evaluation is not assessment). Also the pre-pass 'boilerplate' flags on teaching_methods, learning_outcomes, reading_list and course_content for TYSDI courses are false alarms: the text is identical across offerings of the same course but is genuine content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source page structure places the evaluation sentence in the Vurderingsformer block; no extractor fix possible by heading alone.
findings.suggested_fix: Low priority: strip sentences starting 'Studentane evaluerer undervisninga' from assessment; consider excluding exact duplicates across offerings of the same course from the pre-pass boilerplate flag.
